title: Killer Mom Thinks She Got Away with Murdering Daughter's Boyfriend
description:
When 16-year-old Josue "Jay" Ruiz, the boyfriend of a pregnant teen, is gunned down in an alley in Albuquerque, New Mexico, investigators are led to his girlfriend's family. Surveillance footage of their car and contradictory stories quickly root out a prime suspect. A trail of text messages, jail phone calls, and a shocking confession from another brother ultimately expose the killer's scheme. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
